craft_notes: Sthāyin: cakrodaya unit 44. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 12. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Unjoined in śakti-path but not recited by rising who; they not succeed by effort recited by hundreds of millions even.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ayuktāḥ śaktimārge tu na japtāścodayena ye te na siddhyanti yatnena japtāḥ koṭiśatairapi
